weakness: Integrator remote access is always on, unrestricted, unapproved per session, shared, and without MFA; remote desktop port forward found open to the internet
source: P07 (AC-17 objectives); P01 R-002, R-025; P03 PR.AA-03
remediation_plan: Remove the always-on tool; vendor sessions only through an MSP-managed session tool with named accounts and MFA, enabled per session by the Field Superintendent and logged; written remote access rules (POL-02 B.4)
milestones: 2026-08-11 port forward removed; 2026-10-15 session tool in place; 2026-10-31 old tool removed

weakness: Flat field office network: SCADA host, field PCs, and Wi-Fi on one network behind an ISP router; no monitored boundary
source: P07 (SC-7 objectives); P01 R-001; P03 PR.IR-01
remediation_plan: Small industrial firewall separating the SCADA host and radio base; remove the remote desktop shortcut; visitor Wi-Fi separated; router and firewall configuration saved; quarterly external scan
milestones: 2026-09-30 design approved; 2026-11-30 firewall in place; 2026-12-31 first quarterly scan
resources_required: About $3,000 (hardware and MSP and integrator labor)

weakness: SCADA host backup only on an attached USB drive; controller programs only on one laptop; field computers not backed up; cloud versions deletable by one login
source: P07 (CP-9 objectives); P01 R-003; P04 finding 2
remediation_plan: Two encrypted drives rotated weekly with one at the main office; controller programs and SCADA documentation copied to the restricted Field folder; SCADA host added to the cloud backup with 90-day immutable retention
milestones: 2026-09-30 rotation started; 2026-10-31 programs copied; 2026-12-31 immutable cloud copy

weakness: No contingency plan test; no restore of the SCADA host or the cloud backup has ever been tried
remediation_plan: MSP restore test of the shared drive; SCADA host restore onto a spare PC with the integrator; quarterly tests recorded; tabletop using the P08 runbook
milestones: 2026-09-30 first MSP restore test; 2026-10-30 first SCADA restore test; 2026-11-30 tabletop
resources_required: Spare PC (in POAM-003 budget); integrator time

weakness: No account procedure, approvals, or reviews; shared HMI and integrator accounts; unused contractor account on the SCADA host
remediation_plan: Account procedure (POL-02 B.1 to B.6); named HMI accounts for the Field Technician and integrator; sign-in sheet for Lease Operators; quarterly review; remove the old radio contractor account
milestones: 2026-09-30 procedure and old account removed; 2026-11-30 named accounts; 2026-12-31 first quarterly review

weakness: No time limit or checklist for departures; shared passwords and gate code never changed
remediation_plan: Last-day checklist (POL-02 B.5) covering every system, shared password, Wi-Fi, and gate code; change the HMI and Wi-Fi passwords and gate code now
milestones: 2026-07-22 leaver account disabled; 2026-09-15 passwords and gate code changed; 2026-09-30 checklist in use

weakness: Backup console, mobile viewer administrator, SCADA host administrator, and integrator tool accept a password alone
remediation_plan: MFA on the backup console (MSP) and the mobile viewer; SCADA host administrator reachable only from the console or the MFA session tool; integrator covered by POAM-001
milestones: 2026-09-30 backup console and mobile viewer MFA; 2026-10-31 SCADA administrator path

weakness: SCADA host unsupported and unpatched since 2024; firmware updates untested and unrecorded; no time limits
remediation_plan: Replacement SCADA host on a supported operating system; vendor-approved monthly patching through the MSP; 30-day limit for security updates; firmware levels in the OT inventory
milestones: 2026-10-31 engineering laptop enrolled with the MSP; 2026-12-31 replacement host in service

weakness: SCADA host signatures 5 months old; engineering laptop unprotected; alerts seen only in business hours; scans during the night alarm window
remediation_plan: MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerting on all computers, including the SCADA host after SCADA vendor approval; scans moved to a daytime window
milestones: 2026-09-15 scan window moved; 2026-10-31 contract signed; 2026-12-31 deployed

weakness: No inventory of the SCADA host, controllers, radios, and modems; drawings out of date
source: P07 (CM-8 objectives); P01 R-010; P03 ID.AM-01
remediation_plan: OT inventory (model, firmware, address, location, owner) and a one-page network drawing; reviewed quarterly
milestones: 2026-10-31 site survey; 2026-11-30 inventory and drawing approved

weakness: No security training at hire or yearly; no phishing exercises
remediation_plan: Annual online training with a field module (phishing, USB drives, odd HMI behavior, bank change calls); quarterly phishing exercises

weakness: No incident response plan at fieldwork
source: P07 (IR-8 objectives); P01 R-019; P03 ID.IM-04
remediation_plan: Approve and distribute POL-03 and the P08 runbook; printed binders at both offices and in each truck; tabletop with the MSP and the integrator; annual update
resources_required: Staff time; MSP and integrator time

weakness: No security or data-use requirements for vendors; no oversight of the MSP, integrator, or SCADA vendor; vendor enabled write-back without approval
source: P07 (SA-9 objectives); P01 R-014, R-022; P03 GV.SC-05
remediation_plan: Vendor checklist (POL-02 A.5); security schedule at renewal; annual SOC 2 or questionnaire review of the 4 critical vendors; monthly check that the SCADA connector is send-only
milestones: 2026-08-20 production accounting SOC 2 reviewed; 2026-08-26 write-back off; 2026-11-30 SCADA vendor terms; 2027-03-31 all contracts
